paragraphs.text: 1. O AGNI, shared by all men living bring us good luck for sacrifice from earth and heaven.
paragraphs.original: स्वस्ति नो दिवो अग्ने पृथिव्या विश्वायुर्धेहि यजथाय देव ।
paragraphs.translit: svasti no divo agne pṛthivyā viśvāyurdhehi yajathāya deva |

paragraphs.text: With us be thine intelligence, Wonder Worker! Protect us, God, with thy far-reaching blessings.
paragraphs.original: सचेमहि तव दस्म प्रकेतैरुरुष्या ण उरुभिर्देव शंसैः
paragraphs.translit: sacemahi tava dasma praketairuruṣyā ṇa urubhirdeva śaṃsaiḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. These hymns brought forth for thee, O Agni, laud thee for bounteous gifts, with cattle and with horses.
paragraphs.original: इमा अग्ने मतयस्तुभ्यं जाता गोभिरश्वैरभि गृणन्ति राधः ।
paragraphs.translit: imā agne matayastubhyaṃ jātā gobhiraśvairabhi gṛṇanti rādhaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Good Lord, when man from thee hath gained enjoyment, by hymns, O nobly born, hath he obtained it.
paragraphs.original: यदा ते मर्तो अनु भोगमानड्वसो दधानो मतिभिः सुजात
paragraphs.translit: yadā te marto anu bhogamānaḍvaso dadhāno matibhiḥ sujāta

paragraphs.text: 3. Agni I deem my Kinsman and my Father, count him my Brother and my Friend for ever.
I honour as the face of lofty Agni in heaven the bright and holy light of Surya.
paragraphs.original: अग्नेरनीकं बृहतः सपर्यं दिवि शुक्रं यजतं सूर्यस्य
paragraphs.translit: agneranīkaṃ bṛhataḥ saparyaṃ divi śukraṃ yajataṃ sūryasya

paragraphs.text: 4. Effectual, Agni, are our prayers for profit. He whom, at home thou, Priest for ever, guardest
paragraphs.original: सिध्रा अग्ने धियो अस्मे सनुत्रीर्यं त्रायसे दम आ नित्यहोता ।
paragraphs.translit: sidhrā agne dhiyo asme sanutrīryaṃ trāyase dama ā nityahotā |

paragraphs.text: Is rich in food, drawn by red steeds, and holy: by day and night to him shall all be pleasant.
5. Men with their arms have generated Agni, helpful as some kind friend, adorned with splendours,
And stablished as Invoker mid the people the ancient Priest the sacrifice's lover.
6. Worship, thyself, O God, the Gods in heaven: what, void of knowledge, shall the fool avail thee?
paragraphs.original: स्वयं यजस्व दिवि देव देवान्किं ते पाकः कृणवदप्रचेताः ।
paragraphs.translit: svayaṃ yajasva divi deva devānkiṃ te pākaḥ kṛṇavadapracetāḥ |

paragraphs.text: As thou, O God, hast worshipped Gods by seasons, so, nobly-born! to thine own self pay worship.
paragraphs.original: यथायज ऋतुभिर्देव देवानेवा यजस्व तन्वं सुजात
paragraphs.translit: yathāyaja ṛtubhirdeva devānevā yajasva tanvaṃ sujāta

paragraphs.text: 7. Agni, be thou our Guardian and Protector bestow upon us life and vital vigour.
paragraphs.original: भवा नो अग्नेऽवितोत गोपा भवा वयस्कृदुत नो वयोधाः ।
paragraphs.translit: bhavā no agne'vitota gopā bhavā vayaskṛduta no vayodhāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Accept, O Mighty One, the gifts we offer, and with unceasing care protect our bodies.
paragraphs.original: रास्वा च नः सुमहो हव्यदातिं त्रास्वोत नस्तन्वो अप्रयुच्छन्
paragraphs.translit: rāsvā ca naḥ sumaho havyadātiṃ trāsvota nastanvo aprayucchan
